note: Binds each rendered PNG in this directory to the exact SVG bytes it was rendered from. A count inside an image cannot be text-searched by a test, so the image's text is pinned in its .mmd source and its SVG, and this record catches the remaining gap: an SVG corrected without its PNG being re-rendered. Regenerate with tools/render-diagram.sh <name>, which re-renders the PNG and rewrites the entry together. Checked by tests/scenario_count_doc_sync.rs.
